title: Updating a coin model after each flip
description: You can follow two Beta parameters through the supplied observation sequence.

steps.description: The mean is alpha divided by alpha plus beta. You increase alpha for heads and beta for tails, rejecting other outcome strings.
The driver starts at Beta(2, 2) and supplies H, T, H, H, H. You print the initial mean 0.500 before processing any flip.

steps.question: What parameters follow the first head and then the tail?
steps.answer: They become 3 and 2 after the head, then 3 and 3 after the tail.

steps.description: You keep the updated pair for each next flip and print a row after every update. The final recorded pair is 6 and 3 with mean 0.667.
